title: Per-token SLI derivations, regional circuit-breaker visualization, and preemptive load-shedding dashboard
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: produce a repeatable derivation for per-token SLIs across sequence lengths, add minimal-cost instrumentation for token-level latency and KV-cache hit rates, and ship a set of Grafana dashboards and alerts that make multi-region failover and circuit-breaker activity actionable for SREs and on-call engineers. Motivation: existing golden-signals dashboards aggregate at request-level which masks variance introduced by long contexts and caching; this ticket defines how we compute token-normalized latency SLIs, surfaces region-to-region failover hotspots, and visualizes circuit-breaker state transitions to guide automated load-shedding and throttling policies.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: New metrics emitted by runtime: token_latency_histogram (buckets up to 300ms per token), token_count, kv_cache_hit_rate, and circuit_breaker_state with region and model tags.

AC2: Per-token SLI calculation documented and automated: baseline derivation script that normalizes request latency by model and sequence_length and outputs percentile SLI (P50/P95/P99) for tokens across defined traffic slices.

AC3: Grafana dashboards created: 1) Token SLI Explorer (model x region x seq_len), 2) Regional Failover Heatmap (requests rerouted + latency delta), 3) Circuit-breaker Timeline + Trigger Correlator, 4) Load-shedding Policy Visualizer showing effect of shedding thresholds on unit cost and error rates.
AC4: Alerts: paging SLO alert for token-SLI bleed (P95 > target for 10m), non-paging warning for rising kv_cache_miss_ratio, and circuit-breaker thrash detection with a suppression window.
AC5: Runbook: On-call runbook created and linked with step-by-step remediation (rollback, manual failover, throttling adjustments) and post-incident notes template.
AC6: Load tests demonstrate that preemptive load-shedding policy reduces tail latency and prevents SLO breaches in >80% of simulated overload scenarios.
AC7: Changes merged: runtime PR and observability PRs reviewed, security review (if needed) completed, and rolling rollout plan documented.
AC8: Back-compat: metrics emitted with new names but retain request-level facades for downstream consumers for 30 days (migration window).
AC9: Dashboards have links to underlying queries, units, and owner contact info.
AC10: updated_at reflects latest rollout verification and metric sanity checks (no metric cardinality explosion observed after 48h in staging).
tasks: T1: Design SLI derivation: choose normalization (latency_ms / token_count) vs per-token histogram; produce experiment plan and pick default for SLO (Aisha).
T2: Add runtime instrumentation: emit token_latency_histogram, token_count tag, kv_cache_hit boolean and circuit_breaker_state gauge (Tomás).
T3: Implement aggregation pipeline: new PromQL/InfluxQL queries and retention policy to support percentiles and heatmap slices (observability team).
T4: Build Grafana dashboards and panels; include drilldowns and share links (Dashboards: /grafana/d/ri-token-sli).
T5: Create alerts and test in staging with synthetic load; tune thresholds to minimize false positives (SRE lead).
T6: Run synthetic load tests with variable sequence lengths, cache-hit ratios, and inter-region failovers; record results (benchmarks attach).
T7: Documentation and runbook: write playbook for triage and escalation and link to incident template (Confluence PR).
T8: Rolling rollout: canary 10% serving nodes -> 50% -> 100% with metric sanity gates and rollback steps (release engineer).
T9: Post-deploy verification: 48h metric stability check, cardinality audit, and cost impact analysis.
T10: Postmortem checklist item: if any SLO breached during rollout, open incident and follow RCA process.
T11: PRs: runtime repo PR #1489 (instrumentation), observability repo PR #903 (queries/dashboards), docs PR #332 (runbook).
T12: Coordinate with PM and Design for dashboard layout and prioritization of panels for on-call usability (UX review notes).
T13: Add backward-compat facades to metric names as shim for 30 days.
